children: How long does dating app development take?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-b1ffeab e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: A basic dating application takes 3 to 6 months. Platforms with advanced AI matchmaking, video calling, and location-based discovery take 9 to 12 months and above. Timeline is defined precisely in the Discovery Sprint based on scope and complexity.
Can you build a dating app around our specific concept?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-c7a3b5a e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: Yes. Every application is built from scratch around your brand identity, target audience, and business objectives. No templates. No generic solutions adapted to fit your context.
What features can our dating app include?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-f2b1d5d e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: User profiles, real-time chat, AI-based matchmaking, geolocation, swiping, push notifications, video calling, and in-app purchases are all buildable. The right feature set is determined in Discovery based on your specific audience and business model.
Do you provide support after launch?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-318320f e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: Yes. Performance monitoring, bug fixes, feature updates, and scaling support are provided continuously after deployment. The engagement does not end at launch.
How do you protect user data in dating applications?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-b6cc1ef e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: End-to-end encryption, secure API integrations, multi-factor authentication, and GDPR-compliant data practices are built into every dating platform. User privacy and data security are architectural decisions, not post-launch additions.
